responsibility: Declares IRA’s internal interfaces, data structures, and inline policy helpers shared across the allocator implementation. It defines the loop-tree node representation for allocation regions, internal assertions, allocno/copy/object types, frequency macros, and key inline decisions such as caller-save handling, subloop allocation compatibility, region-merging checks, and loop-border cost formulas. Unlike ira.h’s external interface, this header is the private coordination point for IRA build, lives, conflicts, coloring, and emit code.
